intended_object: The diagonal map α → Sym2 α, x ↦ {x, x}: the image of the diagonal embedding of α into α × α, passed to the symmetric square. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body is `s(x, x)`, which is `Sym2.mk (x, x)`. This is exactly the class of the diagonal pair (x, x) in the symmetric square, so it matches the docstring. The type `α` is arbitrary, which is the natural generality. This declaration is Mathlib's own definition of the object, so there is no separate counterpart to cite.
